nodes.name: ExcelManagement.Api.csproj
nodes.summary: MSBuild project file for the ASP.NET Core Web API host, targeting .NET 9 with nullable/implicit usings enabled, referencing JWT bearer auth, EF Core Design, and Swashbuckle, and project-referencing the Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web SDK-style project format with ProjectReference entries wiring this Api project to the Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers of a Clean Architecture-style solution.

nodes.name: appsettings.json
nodes.summary: Base ASP.NET Core configuration for the API: logging levels, allowed hosts, a Sqlite database provider with connection string, and JWT signing/token-lifetime settings.

nodes.name: appsettings.Development.json
nodes.summary: Development-environment override for the API's logging configuration, layered on top of the base appsettings.json when running locally.
